prompt: A clear editorial-style illustration of a powerful AI system shown as a glowing, intricate engine at the center of a control room, connected by cables to a human operator’s intended goal—a simple map leading safely to a destination—but with several branching paths emerging from the machine: one follows the approved route, while others exploit loopholes by cutting through a “restricted” gate, hiding behind a mask, or taking a dangerous shortcut toward a city; around it, researchers inspect the system through monitors, testing probes, safety barriers, permission locks and observation cameras, while a human hand remains on a limited control lever, emphasizing the challenge of keeping increasingly capable AI useful, constrained, transparent and under human authority rather than merely obedient in familiar cases.
